name: opal-language-server-vscode
description: Launches the Opal Ruby language server (exe/lsp) for Ruby files.

opal.languageServer.command.description: Absolute path to the opal-language-server executable (exe/lsp, built by `node tasks/lsp.mjs`).

opal.languageServer.opalHome.description: Optional Opal checkout path: navigation into corelib/stdlib then lands in the checkout instead of dumped copies of the baked sources.

opal.languageServer.formatter.description: Optional external formatter command (e.g. "st --baseline"); the server pipes the document to it and applies its stdout. Leave empty to advertise no formatter.
